name: Plucked
author: Emilie Gillet
description: Braids' PLUK: three round-robin Karplus-Strong voices, a noise burst dropped into a resonant loop per strike. Inharmonic-string is the same round robin with a far more elaborate model; this keeps PLUK's own stochastic damping instead.

controls.label: Pluck
controls.description: How much of one string period gets struck with noise, from a narrow flick to most of the cycle.

controls.label: Damping
controls.description: Below noon, extra muting under the decay. Above noon, random skipped filter passes stretch and detune it toward metal.

controls.label: Spread
controls.description: Offsets each round-robin voice by a fixed interval, building a small chord. Unison, the module, at noon.

controls.label: Stretch
controls.description: How far Damping's random detuning reaches: off at the bottom, the module's ceiling at noon, past it above.

outputs.aux: Mono: the raw noise excitation only, silent between strikes. Stereo: dropped in favour of panning each voice to a fixed round-robin position.
